A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
The submission deadline is fixed at 1 March 2026 for all evaluations. Manuscripts require a minimum length of exactly 22 pages to qualify. Regarding format, you must apply the official template or provide 3 years of documented revision history unless the track is D, which exempts R2 but mandates exactly 2 endorsements instead. Venue restrictions prohibit handling manuscripts presented at a Tier-1 venue if occurring less than 18 months before the deadline, with exactly 18 months failing qualification. Prior round acceptances block submissions fewer than 5 years elapsed since that round; exactly 5 years elapsed is fine. Withdrawals reset venue clocks treating presentation as occurring on withdrawal date rather than actual, without counting as acceptances under R4. Paired submissions are permitted for exactly 2 manuscripts only; both independently satisfy length and format requirements while at least one satisfies the venue rule. Retractions override all other rules, ensuring unhandled status regardless of criteria including R9. Figure counts must fall between 8 and 45 inclusive, though paired submissions allow up to 70 figures with the same minimum. Submissions failing figure limits by carrying fewer than the minimum receive a PADDED verdict after padding; exceeding maximums returns outright. If a submission would pad but fails another rule, it returns instead. Valid submissions resolve as HANDLED.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":505558388,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
